![Photo by [Taylor Deas-Melesh](https://unsplash.com/@taylor_deas_melesh?utm_source=medium&utm_medium=referral) on [Unsplash](https://unsplash.com?utm_source=medium&utm_medium=referral)](image-1.jpg){fig-alt="Photo by Taylor Deas-Melesh on Unsplash"}

It was so sweet \
the pain \
Until it was not \
 \
Until the joy \
turned into \
a MF drought \
 \
Drought only relieved \
With just one \
Little bit of compassion \
 \
Compassion not \
For one like me \
Living beyond the doubt in doubt \
 \
Doubt that harms the soul \
From deep down \
I crawl \
 \
Crawl to the only place \
Still accepting members \
With a cold stone at the header
